content: Is Bentuǥan ni Hadì Ahasuerus wey ni Mordecai
Ne impevayad ni Hadì Ahasuerus te vuhis is langun he meǥinged dutun te ginhedian din, ragkes sikan is diyà ebpen-ubpà te meziyù.

Ne is langun he nehimu ni Hadì Ahasuerus tenged te kezekelà te ǥehem din, wey is tivuuk he keguǥuza te utew kegkeventuǥa ki Mordecai, ne ingkesurat diyà te Libru he Midsuratan te menge Keguǥuza te menge Hadì te Media wey Persia.

Ne si Mordecai, ebpeketinundug is kandin he kegkelavew te utew kegkelavew ni Hadì Ahasuerus. Si Mordecai edlingahaan wey edtehuzen te zuma zin he menge Judio, ne edtehuzen dan sikandin su nekeveǥey te keupiyaanan te menge emurè din te inged, wey te zuma zin he menge Judio, wey nekidlalag sikandin te hadì para kandan.
